compressPdf.name: Compress PDF
compressPdf.notPdf: This is not a PDF. Choose a PDF file, or use Images to PDF for photos.
compressPdf.warning: Pages are saved as images, so the text can no longer be selected or searched. It still looks the same.
compressPdf.useAsIs: Upload your original file as it is.

common.resultEmpty: Your new file shows up here, with its size check and a Download button.
common.resultFail: Not ready yet: a check failed
common.downloadOff: Download turns on when every required check passes.

compress.minKbHint: Leave empty unless your form gives a minimum, like 20 KB for IBPS photos.
compress.keepDims: Keep the same width and height
compress.keepDimsOn: Width and height stay exactly the same. Only the quality changes.
compress.keepDimsOff: The picture may get smaller in pixels (at most 2000 px on the long side) so it stays sharp at low KB.
compress.tryDownscale: Tip: turn off "Keep the same width and height" so the picture can get smaller.

errors.targetInvalid: Enter a target from 5 to 5000 KB.
errors.minInvalid: The minimum must be a number of 0 KB or more.
errors.minAboveMax: The minimum is bigger than the target. Lower the minimum.

resize.lockHint: The other side follows so the picture is not stretched.
resize.dpiHint: Used to turn cm, mm or inches into pixels, and written into the file. 200 if your notice gives none.
resize.dpiHintPx: Written into the file. Leave 200 if your notice gives none.
resize.upscale: This is bigger than your original, so it may look a little soft.

errors.dims: Enter a width and height from 1 to 8000 pixels.
errors.kb: Enter a maximum from 1 KB, or leave it empty.

about.jpg: JPG: what exam portals want. Small files, no transparency.
about.png: PNG: exact pixels and transparency. Bigger files.
about.webp: WebP: small files for websites. Most exam portals don't accept it.

ink.customSub: Type the pixels and KB range from your notice
ink.customHint: Leave width and height empty if your form gives only a KB range.
ink.invalid: Check the size: a maximum of 5 KB or more, a minimum below it, and both width and height (or neither).
ink.signTip: Sign on plain white paper with a black pen. Fill the box.
ink.thumbTip: Press your left thumb on an ink pad, then on white paper. Photograph it from above in daylight.

declaration.step1: 1. Get the text and print a trace sheet
declaration.textPlaceholder: I, ____ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that…
declaration.needText: Paste the declaration text to make a trace sheet.
declaration.step3: 2. Resize the photo of your page
declaration.step3Body: After writing it by hand, photograph the page and fit it to your form's rule.
declaration.scanTip: Photograph the written page from straight above in good light. Crop to the text.

list.help: Drag to reorder, use the arrow buttons, or focus a row and press Alt + Up or Alt + Down.

pdf.tooMany: Only {max} files fit in one PDF. {n} were not added.
pdf.limit: Keep the PDF under a size limit
pdf.limitHint: Turn off if your form has no KB limit.

sheet.tip: Use a recent photo facing the camera, on a plain light background, in daylight.
sheet.capacity: Up to {n} copies of this size fit on this paper.
sheet.printTip: Print at 100% (actual size), not "fit to page". Then cut along the grey lines.

batch.tooMany: Only {max} images per batch. {n} were not added.
batch.started: Compressing {n} images, one at a time.

errors.dims: Enter both width and height (1–8000 px), or leave both empty.
errors.kb: Enter a maximum from 1 to 5000 KB, and a minimum below it.

increase.maxKbHint: The upper limit from your form. Each chip starts at a common published range; change it if your form says otherwise.
increase.keepPixelsOn: Width and height stay exactly the same. Only the file size goes up.
increase.keepPixelsOff: If the photo is too big for the maximum, it may get smaller in pixels.
increase.how: How it works: we save your picture again at a higher quality. If it is still too small, we add very faint noise you cannot see, and if needed, hidden filler data that image viewers ignore. The picture looks the same.
increase.already: Your file is already {kb}, which is above {min} KB. You may not need to make it bigger.
increase.tryShrink: Tip: turn off Keep pixel size so a very large picture can get smaller.

errors.minInvalid: Enter a minimum from 5 to 5000 KB.
errors.maxInvalid: Enter a maximum from 5 to 5000 KB.
errors.maxBelowMin: The maximum must be bigger than the minimum.

nameDate.name: Name to print
nameDate.nameHint: Spell it as on your application form. It stays on your device.
nameDate.dateHint: Usually the day the photo was taken, as DD/MM/YYYY. Starts at today.
nameDate.style: Printed in black on a white strip below your face, name above date, inside the final size.
nameDate.photoTip: Use a recent photo with your face and shoulders on a plain light background.
nameDate.customSub: Leave width and height empty for passport size (3.5×4.5 cm)
nameDate.customHint: Type the numbers from your notice. Width and height go together.

errors.nameMissing: Type the name to print on the photo.
errors.dateMissing: Type the date to print on the photo.
errors.invalid: Check the size: width and height together (1–8000 px), and a maximum from 5 to 5000 KB above the minimum.

flow.goalRange: We'll make your photo between {min} and {max} KB.
flow.goalPdf: Add your photos. We'll join them into one PDF under {kb} KB.
flow.goalPdfAny: Add your photos. We'll join them into one PDF.
flow.goalCustom: Type your form's size above, then add your photo.
flow.moreOptionsHint: Only if your form asks for something different.
flow.changeSizeHint: Now: {kb} KB. Tap to pick another size.
flow.adjustHint: We cut it for you. Open this if something is cut off.
flow.readySub: Right size. Download it, then upload it on your form.
flow.failSub: One check did not pass. The list below shows what to change.
flow.whichExamHint: Not in the list? Choose "Custom size" and type the size from your notice.
flow.dpiHint: Leave as is unless your form asks for it.
flow.formatHint: JPG for photos. PNG only if your form asks for it.
flow.shareHint: Send this link to friends filling the same form.
flow.minKbCustomHint: Leave empty unless your form gives a minimum.
